items.title: Rejlers to design the expansion of Smørfjord substation for Area Nett in Norway
items.summary: Rejlers to design the expansion of Smørfjord substation for Area Nett in Norway 2026-11-10 08:30:00 Rejlers has been awarded a contract by Area Nett AS to design the expansion of Smørfjord substation in the municipality of Porsanger in Finnmark, Norway. The project is part of a major upgrade of the power grid in western Finnmark, aimed at increasing grid capacity and contributing to a more robust and reliable electricity supply in the region. Area Nett will modernise and expand Smørfjord substation with new transformers and switchgear, along with associated buildings and technical infrastructure. items.title: Hans-Jørgen Wibstad appointed CFO of proposed Multiconsult Rejlers
items.summary: Hans-Jørgen Wibstad appointed CFO of proposed Multiconsult Rejlers 2026-10-08 08:00:00 Multiconsult ASA (OSE: MULTI) and Rejlers AB (publ) (STO: REJL B) Hans-Jørgen Wibstad has been appointed Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of Multiconsult ASA, effective 1 November 2026. Upon completion of the proposed merger between Multiconsult ASA and Rejlers AB (publ), subject to shareholder approval and fulfilment of the other closing conditions, he will become CFO of the combined company, Multiconsult Rejlers.
